scripts.dev: npm run build -w @crystal-ball/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @crystal-ball/api" "npm run dev -w @crystal-ball/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run build -w @crystal-ball/api && npm run build -w @crystal-ball/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run test -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run test -w @crystal-ball/api && npm run test -w @crystal-ball/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run test -w @crystal-ball/api
scripts.test:web: npm run build -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run test -w @crystal-ball/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run lint -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run lint -w @crystal-ball/api && npm run lint -w @crystal-ball/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run typecheck -w @crystal-ball/shared && npm run typecheck -w @crystal-ball/api && npm run typecheck -w @crystal-ball/web
